summary: Developers create a Gemini OAuth application in the API Settings console (https://exchange.gemini.com/settings/api), choosing a permanent client type (confidential or public) and receiving a client_id. Registration is instant in Gemini's sandbox environment for testing, but for production the app must be reviewed by Gemini before it is activated, after which the credentials can be used to obtain user authorisation.

steps.title: Open Gemini API Settings console
steps.detail: Navigate to the API Settings page at https://exchange.gemini.com/settings/api in a browser.

steps.title: Create a new OAuth application
steps.detail: In the API Settings console, click the “Create OAuth application” button to start a new app registration.

citations.quote: To get started, create an OAuth application in API Settings.

steps.title: Select client type
steps.detail: Choose either a “confidential” or “public” client type for the app; this choice is permanent and cannot be changed later.

citations.quote: When you create an app you choose its client type, and that choice is permanent

steps.title: Save the application and retrieve the client ID
steps.detail: Enter the required fields (e.g., application name, redirect URIs) and save the app. The unique client_id is displayed in the API Settings page.

citations.quote: Unique ID of your application. This is provided in your API settings.

steps.title: Submit for production review (if needed)
steps.detail: If the app will be used in Gemini’s production environment, submit it for Gemini’s review. The app will be activated only after the review is approved.

citations.quote: Gemini reviews your registered application before activating it in production.

nuances.title: Sandbox registration is instant
nuances.detail: Applications created in Gemini’s Sandbox Environment are activated immediately and do not require a review.

citations.quote: You can register applications immediately in the Sandbox Environment for testing.

nuances.title: Client type cannot be changed after creation
nuances.detail: The choice between confidential and public client types is permanent; to change it you must create a new application.

citations.quote: You cannot change a client type after creation.

nuances.title: Production apps require Gemini review
nuances.detail: Before an OAuth app can be used in the live (production) environment, Gemini manually reviews the registration and activates the app only after approval.

citations.quote: Gemini reviews your registered application before activating it in production.

nuances.title: Public clients must not send a client secret
nuances.detail: If the app is registered as a public client, including a client_secret in token requests will cause the request to fail.

citations.quote: Public clients must not send this, and a request that includes it will fail.

whenBlocked.action: Update the application details to address the reviewer’s feedback and resubmit the app for review.
whenBlocked.contact: Contact Gemini Support via the help center or email support@gemini.com.

whenBlocked.situation: Need to change client type after creation
whenBlocked.action: Create a new OAuth application with the correct client type; the original app cannot be altered.
whenBlocked.contact: Gemini Support (support@gemini.com) can confirm the need for a new app if clarification is required.
